notes.title: Progress Update #10
notes.content:
After almost three years of development, Vex Clock finally got its release date today along with a new trailer! Have you seen it yet? Check it out below!

[previewyoutube=qaP33nAre5w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Whoa Slow Down Now, A Release Date?[/h1]

Yup, Vex Clock has gotten its official release date today. While the game was slated for a 2024 release, time and ambition got the better of me and it had to get pushed back. Now here we are, with the game now slated to release on [b]February 21st 2025[/b]! It's crazy to think this game first started development on February of 2022, and after all these years it's reaching the big release. I've been dreaming of this moment and I'm so happy to finally get to this point.

[h1]So What Happens Now?[/h1]

Now we wait! I have plans to start sending out pre-release builds to select playtesters to try and get as much feedback as possible. Want to make sure this release is as stable and good as possible for the public to enjoy. I am [i]very[/i] anxious admittedly. This is the first time I've ever released something on the Steam storefront! But I'm confident y'all will enjoy what I've cooked up.

Thank you for reading this short little dev log. See you when the game releases next month. (^w^)

notes.title: Progress Update #9
notes.content:
I'm back again? With another update post? Unfortunately so! I was hoping to make the next post the release date announcement post, but due to getting caught up with Dave.EXE's new major content update and personal life biz, I haven't had the time to make much progress on the game since July.

[h1]What Have I Been Up To?[/h1]

Since around early July, I got caught up working on Dave.EXE's second bi-yearly update, The Kern Kalamity update. Added a whole new set of maps, enemies, cosmetics and a brand new seasonal event. While I am a bit upset I lost a good three months of time I could've spent on finishing Vex Clock, it was a ton of fun to work on and I'm glad I got it done when I did. Got released back in September if you'd like to check out the launch trailer for that!
[previewyoutube=wvYUNtLAk30;full][/previewyoutube]

Apart from that, I got caught up in some personal life biz I had to take care of so I didn't have as much time to work on Vex Clock as I would've hoped. To fill in the gaps, I worked on and released a few updates to older games as a sort of Halloween treat and compensation for much of my silence and down time post Dave.EXE's update. I'm going to be taking time off this month to spend time with family. But come November I'll be back to work, full of energy and ready to tackle on Vex Clock for good!

[h1]So What About The Release Date?[/h1]

Unfortunately my plans for a 2024 release is very unlikely, so I've updated the store's planned release date from 2024 to 2025. While it's a huge bummer, I don't want to rush out something I'm unhappy with. The game is pretty much beatable from beginning to end, but it's lacking all of its end cutscenes and a proper prologue. I want to be able to spend the time I need to animate all this and make the beginning segment build up the story in a much better way.

I hope y'all understand! I feel really bad for taking as long as I am to finish a game that is so close to completion. Hard to find the motivation to dedicate so much time on a project, but I will finish it! Until next time. (^w^)

notes.title: Progress Update #8
notes.content:
We're finally reaching the finish line, so I've got some new stuff to share this time around in terms of what's been done and what's to come!

[h1]What's Been Done[/h1]
The most important question of all, what's been done so far and how close is the game to being finished? Well good news is, every playable level is complete and a majority of the cutscenes have been finished. I'm currently developing the final level's boss fight segment and will soon be working on all of the endings to the game. After that, I should be able to officially say the game is "finished!"

[h1]What's To Come?[/h1]
Once the final boss fight is finished and all the cutscenes have been wrapped up, it'll just be a matter of play testing and end-game implementation stuff. Planning on going back and polishing older parts of the game and it's storyline to keep it in line with the quality of the newer stuff I've worked on recently. I know I would love to spruce up and expand upon the Prologue to better establish these characters and their motives. The Patreon demo from 2022 didn't give the players enough time to really connect with these characters, so I want to improve upon that when I get the chance. Other than that, it'll just be sprucing up older areas of the game, touching up dialogue and finishing up some backend stuff before I'm able to officially announce a proper and concrete release date!

Final Portion of the Game

[h1]The End[/h1]
And that's the end of this post. I'm very hyped to finish this project, been in the development pipline for almost two and a half years now and I'm so excited to get it out there and hear your thoughts on it! And in case you missed it, I uploaded a short gameplay segment of one of Act 4's levels two weeks back, so be sure to check it out if you haven't. With that, I bid you farewell and I hope you have a wonderful rest of your Sunday.

notes.title: Progress Update #7
notes.content:
Been two months since the last Steam post, but thought I'd drop an update on how the game's shaping up before I take some time away next month visiting some loved ones.

So to start, what's been done since the beginning of February? Well, I spent most of the month working on a big quality of life update for Dave.EXE, which took me a few weeks to get done but am very happy with. For those unfamiliar with Dave.EXE, it's an ongoing game I've been continuously updating and including new content for on my Patreon before I drop it on Steam in the future. Wanted to freshen the game up before I leave it dormant for awhile while I finish Vex Clock. As for March, I've devoted the whole month towards finishing the last few act 4 levels and am now in the final stages of it's development. A lot of cutscenes and the final boss fight is all that's left before I start preparing a playable version for a select few playtesters. Very anxious, and I know it's going to take me some time to animate and work on, but I'll do my best to get it all done in a timely manner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919062/ec99448396bbe3fc0db2aae393709246b2d06a6a.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's Left To Finish?[/h1]

To sum it up, I've got a whole load of cutscenes to make, a final boss fight and plenty of quality of life changes and additions before I'm ready to declare Vex Clock a playable game and send out keys to some playtesters. Here's hoping the next Steam post won't be too many months from now, where I'm able to finally say that the game is finished. Very excited for that day and I hope you're all looking forward to it.

For now, I bid thee farewell and I hope you have a wonderful rest of your evening.

notes.title: Progress Update #6
notes.content:
It's been almost six months since the last progress update on this game, with three of those months being lost to the busyness of life. Still, I have made significant progress towards finishing the game and I intend on getting er' done in the coming months ahead!

Last I spoke, I mentioned how act 4 had barely been worked on and still needed plenty of time in the oven. Now, it's safe to say we're finally nearing the end of Act 4's development! Only a few levels still need to be worked on which shouldn't take much time, with a majority of the work that's ahead of me being cutscene related. I end up spending a [i]lot[/i] of time on cutscenes and it really cuts into my time (no pun intended), which is why act 4 has been taking as long as it has to complete. ;w;

Some gameplay footage of stuff I had been working on last week:
[previewyoutube=5orz2sh2goA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What Comes Next?[/h1]

I'm gonna try to finish the last portion of this game sometime in Spring and aim to release it as soon as I'm happy with the final product. While I may complete the game in the coming months, I may keep going back and polishing older areas of the game to flesh out it's story and gameplay, so I don't want to give a concrete release until I'm confident in the final product. Excited but kind of terrified about finishing and releasing Vex Clock this year, haha

Thank you all for reading and I hope you'll continue to look forward to seeing this game come into fruition. (^w^)

notes.title: Progress Update #4
notes.content:
Been awhile, eh? Last post I briefly went over the current state of the game, as well as some other nitty gritty details. I was hoping to get a post up two months ago, but I got just a little bit caught up in side project business. Some of you may already know what I'm talking about, since Vex Clock isn't my only game being worked on.

So a brief summary; I've had a project on the sidelines that's been keeping the revenue flowing in through Patreon. That is, DaveEXE. I was working on an update to this game, expecting to finish it in roughly a month's time. But ended up going down a rabbit hole and spent four months on it. Reworked a lot of old mechanics, updated the UI, polished up a lot of rough spots and made the game look extra crispy, along with a ton of new content to boot! Unfortunately due to all of that, I was unable to get much done for Vex Clock. But now that it's been completed, I have all the time in the world to work on this game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919062/3094e95072fe70c84fb4d918fa9077e09c538369.png[/img]

Now enough of that. What have I been up to since that update dropped? Well, I've been making swift progress on Act 3, finishing up all the gameplay segments, rewriting old dialogue and wrapping up production on a few cutscenes. All that's left is adding the rest of the story bits and then it's onto Act 4. It's been a long time coming, and I'm really excited to jump into the final act. So much has been planned for it and I've got quite a lot of work ahead of me. Expect more behind the scenes footage that'll be teasing new gameplay elements and such over on Twitter and Youtube.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919062/4f282f50acf5349916f72c5353f694af11478acb.png[/img]

Last but not least, we hit over 250+ wishlists for Vex Clock a little while back! Really happy to see folks are looking forward to playing this game. Gonna do my best to deliver a game you'll really enjoy playing through.

And that about wraps up this news post. Thank you for reading, and I hope you'll look forward to what's to come in the future! (^w^)

notes.title: Progress Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919062/37c1439447a18a02acd9c1bf5f0fc8c291fad3c0.png[/img]

Heyo folks! Thought I'd fill you in on what I've been up to this past month regarding Vex Clock's development and other projects.

[h1]Development[/h1]

I recently finished Act 2 this month and have been moving onto working on Act 3's additional gameplay segments and cutscenes. I've got a lot to do but I'm hoping to finish it all by the end of the year. Looking forward to beginning development on Act 4, gonna be a bit ambitious compared to most of the work I've done lately on the previous acts.

Considering I'm working on a majority of this game on my own and juggling other projects, I'm still genuinely impressed I ended up finishing act 2 when I did. Don't want to strain myself with deadlines of course, but I like to give y'all a bit of transparency on what I'm doing, where I'm at, what I've got left to finish and try to complete it all in a timely manner.

[h1]Other Projects[/h1]

I mentioned "juggling other projects" before, so let me elaborate on that for a bit! Some of you may know about my Patreon and how I try to keep stuff updated over there with new games and builds for previously released games to try and keep things fresh. Back in September I was spending most of my time working on a large content update for one of my temporary Patron exclusive games, Dave.EXE. Ended up spending roughly 4 weeks to complete the Otherworldly Contracts update, but I'm pretty proud about how it turned out! If you wish to check that out, take a gander at the spotlight trailer I released for it back in early October.

[previewyoutube=vpycR8V6a54;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Aside from that project, I plan on getting a one year anniversary update for a previous game of mine quickly wrapped up for late November, so I may be spending less time on Vex Clock during that month. I will say though, once that's completed I should be able to work on Vex Clock full time and wrap up Act 3 before the year ends.

[h1]Final Thoughts[/h1]

And that's a wrap, hope I didn't bore you with this huge wall of text, but I'm happy to be transparent about what I'm working on as to not leave y'all hanging and wondering what's going on. Thank you all for reading, and I'll see y'all in the next post!

notes.content:

Hello and welcome to this relatively short progress update post. Wanted to talk a bit about where I'm at currently and what's to come.

[h2]Development[/h2]

As of right now, acts 1-3 are complete, with some cutscenes and additional gameplay segments missing. I've yet to begin development on the final act until I've polished and finished up everything I need to do with the first three acts. Here's what it's looking like so far.

[i]Act 1[/i]

Cutscenes = 100% Complete
Final Pass = Done

[i]Act 2[/i]

[i]Act 3[/i]

Cutscenes = 15% Complete

[i]Act 4[/i]

Cutscenes = 0% Complete
Final Pass = [Null]

Currently focusing on getting Act 2's cutscenes done before I start looking over everything one last time and moving onto polishing the next act. Really happy with the pace I'm going with this and should hopefully start up on Act 3 by October.

[h2]Reception[/h2]

So far the reception I've gotten from the Patreon exclusive demo has been very positive and I'm super happy to hear that! As some folks know, I've mostly been one to dabble in the horror genre and working in team based projects. So making a solo game like this, something that's more of a personal project and a style of gameplay that's more or less out of my comfort zone to get positive reception means the world to me.

[h2]The End[/h2]

And that's a wrap, hope y'all are looking forward to playing through Vex Clock! Gonna be keeping myself busy all throughout the year to make sure I can deliver a game everyone will be satisfied with. I'll be sure to drop more development posts as milestones are reached or until I've got something significant to discuss.

Thank you for reading and I'll see y'all later!
